title: Duration & Delay
definition: Utilities for controlling the length (duration) of a transition, and how long to wait before starting it (delay).
simpleExplanation: You added a transition, but it's too fast. `duration-500` tells the transition to take exactly half a second (500ms) to complete. `delay-200` tells it to wait 200ms before it even begins.
realWorldExample: A massive dropdown menu. You don't want it to instantly vanish if the user's mouse accidentally slips off it for a millisecond. You add `delay-150` so it waits a moment before fading out.

basic: What is the default duration of a transition in Tailwind if you don't specify one?
intermediate: What is an `ease` function (`ease-in`, `ease-out`) used for alongside duration?

answers.question: Ease function?
answers.answer: It controls the acceleration of the animation over the duration. `ease-in` starts slow and speeds up. `ease-out` starts fast and slows down gracefully at the end (the most natural feeling for UI).
